name: Gladys von Wackenheim
original_name: グラディス・フォン・ワッケンハイム
source:
Daughter of a famous commander, became leader of the rebellion after her father's death. The best swordsman in the Edellant Kingdom, unmatched military strategist and brilliant chess player.

Age: 24-25
